subject: to users:  request for information on Stan uses for our ONR grant

messages.author: da33143a8db60ce8
messages.subject: to users:  request for information on Stan uses for our ONR grant
parts:
Hi all. The U.S. Office of Naval Research is supplying some of the funding for Stan, and they have a request for examples in which "there is a company or an agency (e.g. NGA) that is using some of [our] results (e.g. software or an algorithm) that [we] have developed." This is for our grant on informative priors, but I think we can include just about anything Stan-related. Can you plz help with some examples? If we can give them 50 examples of Stan being used, that would be great! There is an attached form, if you could fill it out to the best of your abilities (don't worry about getting all the details right; I think what's important is just that this ONR-funded work is being used in the real world), we would very much appreciate it. As many of you are aware, we are continually working to secure funding for Stan R&D and this sort of thing is potentially very helpful.
See you
Andrew
